mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_direct_message (user_low_id, user_high_id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, body) VALUES (#{low}, #{high}, #{senderId}, #{recipientId}, #{clientMsgId}, #{body}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, body, created_at FROM im_direct_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND client_msg_id = #{clientMsgId}
